attempts.summary: Configured node1 (10.100.171.10) as the cluster's internal NTP source via chrony (serving on udp/123, allowing 10.100.171.0/24, with local stratum-10 fallback) and node2 (10.100.171.11) as a chrony client pointed exclusively at node1 (public pool removed, systemd-timesyncd disabled on both). Verified with chronyc sources/tracking and live tcpdump NTP request/response capture between the nodes. Then ran the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id + healthy chrony state on both nodes, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time via `shutdown -r now`, polled until each came back, confirmed changed boot_id proving an actual reboot, and re-verified chrony service enabled/active/synced (node1 upstream-synced and serving; node2 synced solely to node1) after each restart.
